Usage: astryx theme palette generate [options] <config>

Generate an OKLCH palette candidate for human review

Options:
  -o, --out <path>  Write a candidate TypeScript or JSON file and a sibling receipt
  --preview <path>  Write a self-contained HTML preview page; the path must end in .html
  -f, --overwrite   Replace existing candidate, receipt, and preview files. Without it, if any of them exists, nothing is written
  -h, --help        display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  a candidate is produced or existing output is left untouched
  1  the request is invalid or output cannot be written safely

Examples:
  # Preview candidate JSON
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme palette generate themes/ocean/palette.config.json
  # Write candidate and receipt
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme palette generate themes/ocean/palette.config.json --out themes/ocean/tokens/ocean.palette.ts
  # Write candidate, receipt, and review preview
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme palette generate themes/ocean/palette.config.json --out themes/ocean/tokens/ocean.palette.ts --preview themes/ocean/tokens/ocean.palette.html

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-palette-generate
